article.title: Prohibition of private tuition by teacher.
article.content: No teacher shall engage himself or herself in private tuition or private teaching activity.
article.html:
28Prohibition of private tuition by teacher.

Section 28 · Chapter IV · page 12 of the Act

No teacher shall engage himself or herself in private tuition or private teaching activity.
